title: Preserve an already-running canonical Resend credential from the active REG.RU Web container into the root-only auth-mail runtime
acceptance: use only the single active REG.RU Compose Web container as the credential source
accept only a complete existing RESEND_API_KEY plus canonical platform sender
normalize only the exact known Unicode sender to its ASCII IDN representation
never output or transport the credential from REG.RU to GitHub
send no email during recovery; real delivery remains mandatory in first-customer production acceptance
perform no root-only runtime mutation when the active Web container has no complete canonical Resend environment
require pinned production DNS and SSH identity before server inspection
reuse scripts/provision-production-p0-password-reset-runtime.sh for delivery keys and transactional-mail runtime
perform no database or deployment mutation
